prompt: Medium close-up, shot from outside a 1920s car through its flat side window, with a normal lens and water beading on the glass. The driver sits in profile turning three-quarters to us: a man of about 30 with a narrow, sharp face, hollow cheeks, a thin bent nose, heavy low brows, flat cap, dark coat. His mouth is shut. Gloved hands grip the top of the big wheel. A slanting band of acid green light crosses his cheek and a band of violet crosses his chest, the rest of the cabin black. Behind him, through the far window, only dark. Thanks.
